comment: This class was awesome. It wasn't boring but wasn't overly challenging. 2 papers per week and a 13pg final that you have a while to work on. Great professor.

LOVE Dr. Merrill!!! Her class is not at all difficult because that is not her goal. She actually wants you to think and develop a sense of self and a sense of ethics. By far one of the best "life lesson" classes I have ever taken. Took both Medical Humanities and "The Doctor Patient Relationship" with her. Awesome can not say enough for her!

I had her twice and the class seems to be overall easy. There are two papers due a week and one book (about 350 pages) due to be read a week. It seems difficult but if you keep up it's really not that bad. She grades on a 1-5 score with 5 being the highest. You have a final paper due and it is basically what you will get in the class.
